purpose: Six research-depth concrete methods; public-source retrieval, bounded claims, no full-book redistributions
output: Each agent owns one JSON file in src/deep containing {methods:[],books:[],subjectGuides:{},retrievalLog:[]}. Do not edit shared modules.

sections.title: Chinese
paragraphs: Original explanations; inline LaTex as $...$ supported

reading.instruction: Exact sections and why to read; make access limits explicit

sourceSchema.title: exact
sourceSchema.reason: selection basis and actual comparative usefulness

requirements: 2 concrete methods >=1500 Chinese chars each excluding bibliography where useful; 8-15 bilingual meaningful keywords, at least 3-5 definitions
All nine section ids present; full worked example; explicit failure example; narrow theorem with exact assumptions; transfer map and unverified/newness labels
3-4 useful selected books per direction normally, at least 1 official Springer book page per method; primary author/academic full text for actual math reading; no guessed theorem/DOI/page

Sources interpreted with cautious actual-read levels. Metadata not full text. Discovery is not proof verification. Read public text within source-specific limits; compose original exposition and original examples, no chapter paraphrase replication
Browse and record exact URLs and retrieval failures. Paywall=>find open author version. Do not bypass. No API key needed for public browsing
Subject guides cover listed related MSC codes, at least 3 questions/branches/approaches and linked method IDs from existing M001-M030
Do meaningful example arithmetic/proof checks and return checked outputs; no claim formal verification or independent peer review
LaTex in JSON needs doubled backslashes. All strings plain except $...$ math; no raw HTML. Multiword crosslinks root handles.
